title: Evolution of terpene synthases in the sesquiterpene biosynthesis pathway and analysis of their transcriptional regulatory network in Asteraceae.
authors: Yang, Xiuping; Meng, Fanbo; Cheng, Qian; Feng, Pengmian; Song, Xiaoming; Chen, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该研究分析菊科萜烯合酶基因家族进化及转录调控网络，虽涉及转录因子调控但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The Asteraceae family, one of the largest angiosperm families, is rich in terpenoid secondary metabolites with significant medicinal value. Asteraceae plants have evolved a diverse array of terpenoid biosynthesis pathways, reflecting their adaptive significance and complex regulatory mechanisms. However, the evolutionary patterns and transcriptional regulatory mechanisms governing these biosynthetic processes remain unclear. This study investigates the evolution and transcriptional regulation of terpenoid biosynthesis genes in Asteraceae. Comparative genomic analysis of 19 Asteraceae and six out-group species revealed that Asteraceae species diverged ~74.03 million years ago and were distinctly divided into three subfamilies. A total of 1714 terpene synthase (TPS) genes were identified, predominantly in the TPS-a and TPS-b subfamilies. Caryophyllene-type sesquiterpene biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) were detected in 10 species, with their formation due to whole-genome duplication (WGD) and tandem duplication. By integrating weighted gene coexpression network analysis (WGCNA) and machine learning methods, key transcription factors regulating caryophyllene synthase (CPS) in Carthamus tinctorius were identified. A multilayered gene regulatory network was constructed to identify potential regulatory factors involved in TPS gene regulation under light stress. By exploring the evolutionary patterns and potential regulatory relationships involved in terpenoid biosynthesis in Asteraceae, this study provides important insights into TPS gene evolution. In addition, the findings also offer guidance for optimizing genetic engineering strategies in terpenoid-based drug development.
abstract_zh: 菊科（Asteraceae）是被子植物中最大的科之一，富含具有显著药用价值的萜类次生代谢产物。菊科植物演化出了多样化的萜类生物合成途径，反映了其适应意义和复杂的调控机制。然而，调控这些生物合成过程的进化模式和转录调控机制仍不清楚。本研究探讨了菊科萜类生物合成基因的进化与转录调控。对19种菊科植物和6种外类群物种的比较基因组分析显示，菊科物种约在7403万年前分化，并明显分为三个亚科。共鉴定出1714个萜烯合酶（TPS）基因，主要分布于TPS-a和TPS-b亚家族。石竹烯型倍半萜生物合成基因簇（BGCs）在10个物种中被检测到，其形成归因于全基因组复制（WGD）和串联重复。通过整合加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）和机器学习方法，鉴定了调控红花（Carthamus tinctorius）中石竹烯合酶（CPS）的关键转录因子。构建了一个多层基因调控网络，以识别光胁迫下参与TPS基因调控的潜在调控因子。通过探索菊科萜类生物合成中的进化模式和潜在调控关系，本研究为TPS基因进化提供了重要见解。此外，研究结果还为优化基于萜类的药物开发中的基因工程策略提供了指导。
